description:
A local-first desktop email client for people who want a calmer, more private inbox.

Pebble is a desktop mail client built with Rust, Tauri, and React. It keeps mail data, the search index, attachments, rules, and application settings on your device by default.
The app is designed around a few practical ideas:
- Your mailbox should stay readable, fast, and quiet.
- Email workflows should be local-first instead of cloud-dashboard-first.
- Privacy controls should be explicit, visible, and easy to override per message.
- Search, snooze, rules, and a Kanban board should work together instead of living in separate tools.
Pebble currently supports Gmail, IMAP, and experimental Outlook accounts.

Highlights

Local-first privacy
- Local SQLite database for messages, folders, labels, rules, and settings.
- Local Tantivy full-text index for fast search.
- Attachments are stored on disk under the app data directory.
- OAuth tokens and credentials are encrypted with a per-device key.
- No telemetry.
- Network requests are limited to features you configure: mail sync, translation, and optional WebDAV settings backup.

Mail workflow
- Unified inbox across multiple accounts.
- Gmail, IMAP, and experimental Outlook support.
- Threaded and message-list views.
- Archive, delete, star, mark read, batch actions, and restore flows.
- Snooze messages and bring them back later.
- Full-text search and advanced filters.
- Rules engine for automatic organization.

Productivity tools
- Kanban board with Todo, Waiting, and Done columns.
- Command palette and keyboard-first navigation.
- Built-in translation providers with bilingual reading.
- Dark and light themes.
- English and Chinese UI.
- Optional WebDAV backup for settings, rules, Kanban cards, and Kanban notes.
Added
- Added an unread-only filter for message and thread lists. A message you open stays listed until you change the filter, folder or view (#75, #112).
- Added automatic IMAP/SMTP settings from the email domain for common providers, with hints when an app password or OAuth sign-in is needed (#36, #112).
- Added an Appearance setting for HTML mail in the dark theme: keep a light card, darken simple mail, or always dark (#103, #112).
- Added drag and drop of messages onto sidebar folders, with the same rules, Undo and partial-failure reporting as Move To (#80, #112).
- Added a launch splash with the Pebble logo and a loading line. When a database upgrade is needed after an update, it runs in the background and the splash shows its progress instead of the app appearing frozen (#113).
Changed
- Restored the amber accent colour, and refreshed secondary buttons, option cards and the Settings navigation (#113).
- Redesigned the Kanban board: a header with open and done counts, clearer columns with empty-state drop zones, richer cards, and quick actions to mark a card done, reopen it or remove it (#113).
- Unread list pages use a dedicated index, so they stay fast in large folders (#112).
- Refreshed the README and website with current features and screenshots (#113).
Fixed
- Quitting (including macOS Cmd-Q) is held while a database upgrade is running, and still works if startup fails (#113).
- mailto: links opened while Pebble is starting or upgrading are no longer lost (#113).
Upgrade notes
- The first launch applies a small database migration (an index for unread lists). Automated tests and package builds cover this release; the background upgrade path has not yet been exercised in a packaged build.
